commonPrompt: Create one original widescreen concept art scene for the Flock and Key vocabulary mini-game described below. The reference image sets the station's approved rendering, palette, architecture and original family identities. Show exactly ONE Pitsi dog in the entire new image, never two. Show one boy with SHORT messy hair, one girl with a ponytail, and one Dad; do not duplicate characters. Preserve these original characters and costumes, NOT any commercial cartoon characters. Flat hand-drawn 2D point-and-click adventure illustration, fixed three-quarter view, broad clean color shapes, strong dark teal and umber contour lines, at most one flat cel shadow per object, cream plaster, faded teal woodwork, terracotta floor, ochre and muted brick-red accents. Remove gradients, paper texture, wood grain, realistic lighting, tiny detail and painterly rendering. Clear theatrical poses and readable silhouettes. The brother has dark tousled hair, teal overshirt, cream shirt, ochre backpack and olive trousers. The sister has a dark high ponytail, brick-red track jacket with pale sleeve stripes and mauve trousers. Dad is broad-built with dark graying hair, short beard, navy cardigan and blue shirt. Pitsi is the small charcoal-and-tan dog with upright ears and a plain narrow dark collar. Keep the key interaction visually dominant, the foreground props separated and the room navigable. One immediate gentle visual gag, not chaotic clutter. This is environmental concept art, not a UI mockup: NO writing, lettering, numbers, logos, speech balloons, interface panels, card borders or watermark. All hands and props should make physical sense.

images.title: מחלקת האבידות של פיצי
images.prompt: SCENE: Lost and Found at the station. A chunky teal lost-property counter is the central stage. The ponytailed sister carefully holds up a clearly striped teal-and-cream scarf to a delighted traveler on the opposite side. A second dotted scarf lies distinctly beside it, plus one closed ochre bag. The brother consults a simple picture of a bench with a bag beside it; the picture has no writing. Dad watches from behind the counter with a raised eyebrow. Pitsi sits by the foreground bench with a soft knitted hat balanced on his head, comically claiming it. Cream walls, teal doorway, warm terracotta tiles, a few broad shapes. The striped versus dotted scarf comparison must be readable. A new staging, not a copy of the reference composition.

images.title: המשמרת בבית הקפה
images.prompt: SCENE: Cafe Shift in the station cafe. The siblings work at a low broad teal serving counter. The sister prepares a cheese sandwich with clearly visible cheese and NO tomato on a cream plate. Bright tomato slices sit separately in a small ingredient dish, next to cheese and bread. The brother presents a second sandwich cut into two equal halves, one half in a simple takeaway carton. The plump cafe owner with a cream headscarf, plum cardigan and apron smiles behind the counter. Dad waits at a small cafe table. Pitsi peers solemnly over an empty dog bowl in the foreground. The wall has an ornate framed sandwich pictogram award and a tiny picture of a collapsed sandwich, absolutely no writing. Clear ingredients, calm spacious composition, flat cream and teal interior with terracotta floor.

images.title: הסדנה של אבא
images.prompt: SCENE: Fix It Dad, a harmless stage-prop workshop. A large wooden workbench fills the center. On it is a chunky teal toy suitcase with one clearly detached curved handle resting beside the attachment sockets. The sister is carefully placing the correct ochre handle on the suitcase; the brother holds the oversized wrong handle, comparing the two. Dad in navy proudly gestures at an absurdly tiny spare handle as a dry visual joke. Pitsi sits under the bench with ears pricked. Behind them a cream wall with teal simple tool silhouettes and an unlettered small stage sign. Emphasize the visible relationship of handle, suitcase and attachment, large legible shapes, no power tools or dangerous machinery. Different three-quarter composition from the station hall.

images.title: רדיו התחנה
images.prompt: SCENE: Message Relay, a public message desk in the station with a view onto the village square. The brother and sister stand beside a simple teal tabletop radio and a large unlettered pictorial village map on a stand. The map has exactly three large place pictograms: station, cafe, bandstand, connected by broad paths. The sister points at the meeting place opposite the cafe while the brother passes a plain cream message card to Dad. Through the open doorway two musicians carry their small drum toward a new meeting spot by a teal bench across from the cafe. Pitsi waits proudly beside a stack of blank message cards, one card under a paw as a visual gag. Calm clear composition, map and communication central, no railway signal equipment, no clocks or readable text.

images.title: מועדון המילים החשאיות
images.prompt: SCENE: Word Detectives and the borrowed lantern. The siblings stand at a small teal investigation table in the village square. An open notebook shows ONLY two simple evidence pictures without text: an empty shelf and a hand returning a lantern. The sister connects these pictures with her pointing gesture while the brother looks toward the cafe owner handing a chunky brass-and-teal lantern back to the relieved event organizer. The original lantern silhouette matches the notebook picture. Dad watches with an amused raised eyebrow. Pitsi sits on a small chair beneath a now-empty lantern hook, comically disappointed that his personal light is gone. The borrowing and return should look friendly and consensual, not theft. Cream village walls, teal cafe door and terracotta paving, broad simple shapes, clear physical evidence rather than an elaborate detective crime scene.
